reason: The public current-layout page identifies the event but its server response does not expose a named bookmaker with a complete 1X2 row; unnamed provider identifiers were not imported.

FotMob reports Newcastle United in the Premier League with one current-season match and West Bromwich Albion in the Championship with two. These are different competitions and insufficient non-comparable samples, so no combined pre-match xG formula was produced.

The public EFL Cup event listing exposes three 1X2 prices only under internal provider identifiers. The public provider-name mapping was unavailable after a 429 response, so no named bookmaker 1X2 row was imported.
The frozen fixture is 2026-09-09 Dortmund vs Villarreal, but the linked official result is 2026-09-02 Stoke City vs Norwich under a reused weekday sequence.
